evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Requiring no training or auxiliary computation, stride-k subsampling exploits Whisper's preprocessing redundancy, indicating that its audio-token interface carries more capacity than downstream tasks require.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The same configuration extends to three Whisper-based SpeechLMs, yielding modest accuracy drops on stronger baselines and larger drops on weaker ones, while reducing end-to-end latency by 19.6-27.4%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five Whisper scales, k=2 preserves baseline WER at both positions, with CKA attributing this stability to acoustic overlap at the stem and attention-induced redistribution at the encoder output.
